caption: The drawing depicts a single broom positioned vertically in the center of the image, against a plain, light beige or off-white background. The broom consists of two parts: a handle and bristles. The handle is short and tapers slightly towards the top, colored in a medium brown shade with some lighter areas giving a sense of texture or wear. The bristles are long, dense, and spread outwards at the base, colored in various shades of yellowish-brown to orange, indicating a straw-like material. The overall composition is simple, with the broom being the only object and no additional elements or background details present.
title: Shaker Broom
